invariants: Cognigrex is the proper noun for the complete living parent filespace/intelligence architecture.
Römer-Grex, Eco-Grex and LightSpeed/EMC² are tailored child systems, not alternate names for Cognigrex.
Child domain authority does not become parent authority merely because the child is mounted.
Cross-domain links reference child objects by stable identity; state is not copied for convenience.
Runtime evidence such as leases, heartbeats, host conformance runs and transient app handoffs remains Host-local unless explicitly promoted.
CCC is shared at the parent/kernel layer rather than duplicated inside each sister.
EMASSC.cgx owns scientific/governance/methods context; LS.cgx owns execution/runtime semantics.
A child may later be EMBED, TRACK, PIN or REFERENCE according to deployment/security needs without changing its semantic identity.

Romer.cgx/Mark III requirement -> validation request -> EMASSC.cgx/test method
EMASSC.cgx/test method -> executed_by -> LS.cgx/Python or device capability
